articles.highlight: 1962年，肯尼迪政府急于扭转巴西国会选举，以打击左翼总统古拉特，应对所谓共产主义威胁。

articles.title: Show HN: Nightcrawler – A local AI pentesting agent running on a smartphone
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + HN discussion
articles.summary: 这篇文章展示了名为 Nightcrawler 的开源项目，它让 AI 渗透测试代理完全在手机本地运行，避免将敏感数据发送到云端。项目在 Hacker News 获得 120 分和 35 条评论，说明社区对移动端本地化 AI 安全测试工具兴趣浓厚。值得关注的是它如何平衡端侧算力限制与渗透测试的深度需求。
articles.failureAnalysis: 智能手机的算力、内存和电池续航会严重限制大模型或复杂扫描任务的执行，导致渗透测试覆盖面和准确性不足。同时，本地漏洞库若不实时更新，很快会失去实效性，而云端更新又会削弱“本地”优势。此外，渗透测试本身有法律和伦理风险，个人手机上的工具可能被滥用，作者需要面对监管和分发渠道的挑战。在需求上，专业安全团队通常已有成熟工具链，能否说服他们改用手机端仍是未知数。

articles.failureAnalysis: 此类技能包的可靠性取决于模型对提示的遵循程度，规范越具体，模型越容易选择性忽略或过度执行。团队需要不断测试和维护技能，同时不同模型的升级可能随时破坏技能效果。此外，作为开源仓库，它很难获得持续资金与生态支持，也难以在封闭商业产品中形成标准。

en.highlight: Agent skills can bring team coding standards into Claude Code and Codex workflows.
en.summary: This project defines reusable agent skills for AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Codex, turning team-level coding standards into executable prompts and constraints. With 75 points and 38 comments on Hacker News, it shows real interest in guiding AI helpers with team-specific conventions. It is worth reading because it demonstrates a lightweight skills layer that bridges generic models and team practice.
en.failureAnalysis: The reliability of such skill packages depends on how faithfully models follow the prompts, and any model update can break them. Maintaining compatibility across tools and keeping teams motivated to adopt and update the skills are the main practical constraints.
en.title: Agent skills that bring team coding standards to Claude Code and Codex
